name: Results jump, 10-session hold
author: claude
hypothesis: A 4%+ move on quarterly results on 2x turnover, closing near the high, keeps drifting up over the next 10 sessions (post-earnings drift) while NIFTY is above its 200-day average.
filter: days_since_result == 0 and result_ret >= {jump} and result_turn_mult >= {vol} and result_close_loc >= 0.75 and nifty_above_ma200 == 1
